# Berlin Management Group

> Operations advisory and systems implementation for owner-led and project-driven businesses. BMG helps improve operations, simplify workflows, and implement practical systems that scale. The work starts with the operating problem; software, automation, and AI are used only where they improve execution.

## About

Berlin Management Group (BMG) is an operations advisory and systems implementation practice based in Phoenix, Arizona, founded by Brad Berlin, an operations executive with 20+ years of experience across P&L leadership, operational transformation, customer operations, cost reduction, and scalable systems.

BMG applies that operating background to selective advisory and implementation work. Engagements begin with the operating problem — workflow bottlenecks, unclear ownership, manual handoffs, reporting gaps, or systems that no longer scale — before any technology decision is made.

## Primary Value

- Business-process diagnosis and workflow improvement
- Ownership, accountability, and handoff clarity
- Operational transformation and scalable operating systems
- Software implementation readiness, adoption, optimization, and recovery
- Practical execution and operating cadence
- Automation and AI where they create measurable operating value

## Technology Position

Software, automation, and AI are supporting tools, not the starting point. BMG is not an AI agency, a bot-development shop, or a replacement for established business software. Most businesses will continue to use subscription platforms; the advantage comes from owning the workflow, process decisions, data standards, integrations, and management practices around those systems. Custom automation is added only where standard software stops.

## Industries

- Construction and contracting (a specialty, not the entire practice)
- Field services and trades
- Property management
- Other owner-led or project-driven businesses

## What BMG Does Not Claim

- BMG does not claim platform or vendor certifications unless explicitly documented.
- BMG does not present prior-employer results as BMG client results. Career metrics belong to Brad Berlin's operating career and are labeled as such.
- BMG does not publish client outcomes, customer counts, revenue claims, or testimonials it cannot support.
- BMG does not guarantee savings, staffing avoidance, or specific operational outcomes.

## Ideal Fit

- Owner-led and project-driven businesses, typically 10 to 200 employees
- Leadership willing to participate and assign an internal process owner
- Businesses that have already bought software and need the operating model around it
- Organizations seeking a clear business case before implementation

## Location

Phoenix Metropolitan Area, Arizona, United States
